definitions.explanation: A flooded field where rice is cultivated.

examples.english: I flood the rice paddy with water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{稲田|いなだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{黄金色|こがねいろ}→黄金色：19037_koganeiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
examples.english: In autumn, the rice paddies turn golden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見渡|みわた}す→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧{稲田|いなだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いていた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Rice paddies stretched as far as the eye could see around the village.

notes:
{稲田|いなだ} is a somewhat literary or formal word for rice paddy. In everyday conversation, ⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧ or ⟦{水田|すいでん}→水田：13262_suiden⟧ are more commonly used. {稲田|いなだ} emphasizes the paddy as a field of rice plants (⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧) and is often found in written descriptions of rural scenery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {稲田|いなだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧ — rice paddy scenery
- ⟦{青々|あおあお}→青々：19447_aoao⟧とした{稲田|いなだ} — verdant rice paddies
- {稲田|いなだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|みの}る→実る：00282_minoru⟧ — the rice paddy bears grain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧ — rice paddy (everyday, spoken)
- ⟦{水田|すいでん}→水田：13262_suiden⟧ — paddy field (neutral, common in writing)
- ⟦{田畑|たはた}→田畑：13527_tahata⟧ — fields (rice paddies and dry fields collectively)

NOTE: {稲田|いなだ} is also a common Japanese surname.
